notes:
Test build for verifying the in-app updater end to end.

No functional changes since 1.4.2 — only the version number differs, so you can confirm the update really landed (sidebar footer should read 'JITM v1.4.3').

What to expect when installing this from 1.4.2:
- Check Now fetches the live feed (no 6-hour cache).
- Download verifies size + SHA-256 before it is offered for install.
- Install & Restart takes a safety backup, closes the app, installs silently with a log, and reopens the app on v1.4.3.
- Data Management > Software Update now shows a diagnostics block: install folder (+ writability), last setup exit code, and the installer log tail.
